summary: Diameter nodes have no generic way to know the relative priority of messages when they make routing and resource allocation decisions. This proposed standard defines a mechanism that lets Diameter endpoints indicate the priority of a transaction. Nodes can then use it, for example, when they are overloaded.

eli5.summary: At a busy airport, emergency flights should land first. This lets messages in a network-login system carry a priority label so the important ones get handled first when things get busy.
